visualCharacteristics.structure: header row + label column + text cells

contentPattern: Base: first row = header cells, then one row per data row. compare: header row ['' | product A | product B] then [label | value | value]; features: no header, rows [label | value]; ':check:' / '✓' value cells render as check marks; '-' cells render as a dash; values > 38 chars render as small print
